articles.summary: Conference Call Scheduled for Friday, November 6, 2026 at 11:00 am ET CareTrust REIT, Inc. (NYSE:CTRE) today reported operating results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as well as other recent events. For the quarter, CareTrust reported: Net income of $83.7 million and net income per diluted weighted average share of $0.35, consistent with the prior year quarter; Normalized FFO of $129.2 million and Normalized FFO per diluted weighted average share of $0.54, an increase of $0.09, or 20%
articles.title: CareTrust REIT Announces Third Quarter 2026 Operating Results; Updates 2026 Guidance
